dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, so you have a giant workshop, too! What do you build around here?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, you don't have to say if you don't want to. I was just curious. Anyway, thanks for bringing me here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's great! I got to talk to Tubby for the whole day!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Her full name is even harder to remember than the "Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon." Something to do with rain, I think? I don't get it at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's one of the adepti from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh right, yeah... Another group that can't be explained in terms of science and mechanics...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: That seems to be a recurring theme ever since leaving Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, anyway, Tubby told me building things here is super easy. All you need is a blueprint.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So, I decided to get started on my next machine. I had the design schematic, tools, and components all ready to go, but then she said none of it was useable...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we use adeptal arts instead...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: See? So, it's not easy at all! It's nothing like what I'm used to! I guess that means no tinkering for me...

choices.text: It's okay. Just tell me what you're thinking.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I'm a little sad I won't get to build anything, but as a guest here, I guess it's better not to overstep...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But, uh... could we maybe get a krumkake-maker?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Then, at least, we'll have something to snack on together!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Sure! But, um... Could you help me find my precision machinery hex nut first?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where did you last see it?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe... No idea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, when did you last use it?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hm, when was it? Earlier today? Or maybe yesterday...? Sorry, when I get busy, I tend to lose track of time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, what do you usually do when you lose something?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, that's easy. Whenever my room gets too messy and I can't find something, I just call out, "INEFFA!"

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's the fastest way to fix the situation! Even if it means walking right into a lecture...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh, but you don't have somebody like that to help you. How do you survive?

choices.text: It's just a matter of staying organized...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But, if I had to spend time on cleaning after pouring countless hours into making stuff, there'd be no time left over for snacks!

choices.text: Okay, so snacks are your main concern...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: What!? No, no, no! We need to be a united front! Like... a snack alliance!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Ah, I get it. You've forgotten how good a delicious, crumbly cookie can be, haven't you? Well, you're in luck, 'cause I've got extra! Here, we can—

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Hey! My hex nut! It was in my sleeve the whole time!

choices.text: I think I understand Ineffa a whole lot better now...
After a while, it becomes a habit...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah! I wanna give our krumkake machine a new look!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's just a bit plain right now. I think we can make it stand out a lot more!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What shape do you like? We could do... a robot? Ooh, or a little duck could be cute!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Oh, but I've got the name down already! {NICKNAME}'s Special Sizzling Krumkake Contraption!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How would the robot work?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, it would have a robot arm to do the cooking, and an oven in its chest.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Then, once you hear the sizzling sound, the krumkakes burst from the oven in the chest and the robot's mouth shoots out sugar to dust them with!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, what about the duck?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, first you put the ingredients in the duck's back, and then you press the switch on its wings to activate it.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Then, you wait for the sizzling sound, and... Ta da! You have a whole batch of krumkakes that you can take from the duck's mouth, one after the other!

choices.text: Huh, both sound like good options...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: If you can't decide, why don't we just make both?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: The construction should be pretty simple... And, if there's one thing I know, it's how to execute a vision!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: One small hiccup, though... Taking this machine apart still won't give me the components I need. Looks like I gotta make a quick stop at home...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But, I'll be super quick! So, wait for me, okay? You promise?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Hehe, you see the vision! I knew you would like it!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Then, let's make both! A machine like this deserves to be in the hands of someone who understands its value!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Morning, Ineff— Huh!? {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're here bright and early! Wanna go have some fun?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, is it night already? Aw, man. I wanted to hang out with you for a little longer!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Alright, well... G'night! Come see me first thing tomorrow, okay? Don't forget!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wow, nice! These chairs and carpets sure are familiar! But something's still missing...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Can you guess what's missing? That's right, it needs more Aino! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And that means I'll make sure to come around often to perfect your work. We'll play lots, 'kay?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Do you like building things with sheet metal, too? Oh! Here's a blank wall...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: How about I draw you a mural? I'll draw you, and me, and Ineffa holding hands! Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe. That way, it'll look more like the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop.
